scope_contract.goal: Unified regression across every implemented Surface and capability before native release packaging.
in_scope: capability matrix closure for integrated P00-P19 authority
candidate implementation commit/schema catalog/frontend build/evidence index freeze
P20 release-wide verification contribution through G0-G10
excluded_work: mock substitutes for required real P0 flows
P22 fresh-install or owner-controlled production validation claims

inherited_complete.G2: P03 signed Design System authority, revalidated by applicable UI evidence

later_owned_carry_forward.G1: Execution Stage is P01/P21/P22; P20 must live-bind current P01/native architecture authority and preserve explicit P21/P22 CAP-NATIVE-INSTALL/CAP-NATIVE-ONLY-RELEASE obligations without claiming them complete

cases.name: Exact candidate lineage and normative authority freeze
cases.oracle: Candidate is an exact descendant of the verified P19 integration; Master Plan/IA/Design System and frozen traceability snapshots remain bound; no prior-repository authority is imported.

cases.name: Capability matrix integrated-status closure
cases.oracle: Every REQUIRED capability has an owner/status/evidence disposition; all P00-P19-owned capability authority is integrated; P21/P22 native capabilities remain explicit later-owned obligations and are not falsely completed.

cases.name: Route registry cross-surface closure
cases.oracle: Every approved route row has exactly one current disposition and owner; Website/Docs/Auth/Workspace/Admin/Public paths agree with IA; no invented route, unreachable required route or stale acquisition edge exists.

cases.name: Schema and migration catalog freeze
cases.oracle: Current-repository schema/migration inventory is deterministic, ordered and uniquely identified; P20 evidence binds the exact catalog without importing legacy migrations or claiming P21 package completion.

cases.name: Whole-frontend build inventory and determinism
cases.oracle: admin/docs/site/workspace plus shared packages typecheck/build from the exact candidate; repeated clean builds produce an equivalent publishable inventory and do not introduce production Node runtime.

cases.name: P00-P19 signed integration authority ledger
cases.oracle: Integrated P00-P19 source/integration/closure authority is ancestry- and live-metadata-bound; revision-specific predecessor closure is not re-signed or reinterpreted.

cases.name: Release-candidate evidence index integrity
cases.oracle: Required current and inherited evidence is complete, digest-bound, exact-head where P20-owned, non-expired where live-bound, secret-safe and deterministically indexed.

cases.name: Defect and decision closure ledger
cases.oracle: Open P0=0, P1=0 and DECISION REQUIRED=0; lower-severity defects have explicit disposition and cannot hide a hard Gate failure.

cases.name: Real registration workflow
cases.oracle: Registration executes through the real platform API, persistence, validation and protection path with correlated user/workspace identifiers and no mock authority.

cases.name: Real email verification workflow
cases.oracle: Verification token/grant lifecycle, queued mail evidence and verified-account transition correlate to T009 without exposing secrets or bypassing token rules.

cases.name: Real login session and account workflow
cases.oracle: Verified account logs in through real session/CSRF/Origin/rate protections; browser and API observe the same authenticated identity/workspace and logout/revocation semantics.

cases.name: Real Link create and mutation workflow
cases.oracle: Authenticated user creates and mutates a Link through real API/MySQL/Redis authority with RBAC, version/audit and destination fingerprint/risk invariants preserved.

cases.name: Real redirect routing and safety workflow
cases.oracle: The created Link resolves through redirectengine with risk before UTM/routing/A-B finalization, correct status semantics and correlated click identity; blocked/review/stale/unknown risk fails closed.

cases.name: Real analytics transport aggregate and reconciliation
cases.oracle: T013 click enters Redis transport, analyticsworker aggregation and MySQL reporting; reconciliation is idempotent and the browser/API report correlates to the same Link/click timeline.

cases.name: Real QR lifecycle and decode
cases.oracle: QR is created for authorized content, rendered/downloaded as real assets and independently decoded to the expected target with permission and identifier continuity.

cases.name: Real File quarantine scan publish and download
cases.oracle: File upload enters quarantine, mandatory ClamAV/fileworker decision and publish/download authorization; missing/unhealthy/timeout/indeterminate scan cannot publish.

cases.name: Real Text sharing lifecycle
cases.oracle: Text create/read/update/expiry/access controls operate through real API/persistence and public HTTP semantics while preserving permanent noindex/UGC policy.

cases.name: Real Bio lifecycle and outbound safety
cases.oracle: Bio create/publish/read operates through real authority; child destinations preserve risk invalidation/fail-closed behavior, outbound UGC attributes and noindex/sitemap exclusion.

cases.name: Real custom-domain entitlement ownership HTTPS and risk workflow
cases.oracle: Domain request/entitlement/ownership/DNS/HTTPS/risk axes remain independent and conjunctive; a ticket never grants entitlement; unsafe or not-ready domain cannot be assigned to a Link.

cases.name: Real support ticket reply and mail workflow
cases.oracle: Workspace ticket and Admin reply persist with authorization/audit linkage; mail queue/worker produces secret-safe delivery evidence and attachment malware policy remains enforced.

cases.name: Real billing invoice payment callback and entitlement workflow
cases.oracle: Order/invoice/payment/FX and authenticated provider callback settle idempotently through real service persistence; browser return cannot settle payment and entitlement cannot bypass domain safety.

cases.name: Real notification production and deep-link workflow
cases.oracle: Events from the correlated flow generate deduplicated server-side notifications with read state and authorization-safe deep links; sensitive data is redacted and notifications do not replace audit/mail authority.

cases.name: Real Admin operations action and audit workflow
cases.oracle: Authorized Admin can observe correlated resource/operation state and perform permitted high-risk action with MFA/session/permission/reason requirements and append-only secret-safe audit attribution.

cases.name: API key and outbound webhook integrated lifecycle
cases.oracle: Workspace API key secret-once/scope/rotation/revocation/rate/audit and user-webhook signing/retry/idempotency/SSRF/redirect/DNS-rebinding controls operate against real integrated authority; payment callbacks remain separate.

cases.name: OAuth and Turnstile integrated protection matrix
cases.oracle: Configured OAuth providers preserve state/PKCE/handoff/bind-unbind semantics and Turnstile server verification fails safely across its owned surfaces without account enumeration or token leakage.

cases.name: Correlated whole-product P0 timeline
cases.oracle: The Master Plan sequence register→verify→login→link→redirect→analytics→QR→file→text→bio→domain→ticket→billing→notification→admin is present as one machine-readable timeline with correlated stable IDs and no skipped/mock authority.

cases.name: Cross-resource tenant and RBAC consistency
cases.oracle: Owner/admin/member/viewer and Admin permissions are enforced consistently across API/UI/resources; cross-workspace access and last-owner/privilege bypass are denied server-side.

cases.name: Cross-surface fail-closed safety parity
cases.oracle: Destination risk, domain risk, ClamAV, Turnstile, auth/session and entitlement uncertainty produce consistent deny/review behavior across Website/Public/Workspace/Admin/API/redirect surfaces; no UI success overrides server authority.

cases.name: Domain and destination authority parity
cases.oracle: Official/custom hostnames and primary/routing/A-B/Bio destinations use the same exact-fingerprint invalidation and current risk semantics; entitlement/ownership/DNS/HTTPS/domain-risk axes remain independent.

cases.name: HTTP status and error-state consistency
cases.oracle: Auth/private/public/Website/Docs/UGC/API surfaces use contractual 2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx semantics including 403/404/410/419/429 and do not mask failures as 200 success/soft-404 states.

cases.name: Navigation route and deep-link consistency
cases.oracle: Website/Docs/Auth/Workspace/Admin navigation and notification deep links resolve only approved Route Registry targets with correct authentication/localization context and zero invented/stale links.

cases.name: Release-wide SEO and indexation consistency
cases.oracle: Website/Docs canonical/hreflang/sitemaps/raw HTML plus Text/Bio/private/error noindex exclusions agree; no private/UGC/error acquisition leak, soft 404, orphan index page or crawler-only differential exists.

cases.name: Website and Docs locale-discovery parity
cases.oracle: English/zh-CN Website and Docs localization, reciprocal alternates, x-default and internal acquisition links use only published peers; no fabricated translation or locale route is introduced.

cases.name: Release-wide Design System and visual consistency
cases.oracle: Representative Website/Docs/Auth/Workspace/Admin/Public surfaces conform to exact Design System tokens/states/dark/motion/icon/image rules with no fabricated product UI or placeholder visuals.

cases.name: Release-wide accessibility and responsive matrix
cases.oracle: Representative surfaces satisfy WCAG 2.2 AA evidence, keyboard/focus/labels/contrast/reduced-motion plus desktop/tablet/mobile/320px reflow without overflow, clipping or inaccessible state messaging.

cases.name: Release-wide performance and bundle isolation
cases.oracle: Applicable P04/P07/P19 budgets remain green; Website never loads Workspace/Admin bundles, frozen Website CWV budgets hold and no regression introduces long-task/image/font/cache violations.

cases.name: Observability correlation and secret-redaction consistency
cases.oracle: Eight-service logs/operations/audit correlate required IDs without credentials, tokens, payment signatures, webhook secrets, TXT verification material or other prohibited evidence leakage.

cases.name: Notification mail audit cross-channel consistency
cases.oracle: A correlated business/security event has consistent notification/mail/audit references and authorization semantics; channels neither duplicate authority nor expose secret material.

cases.name: Redis interruption replay and cache-rebuild recovery
cases.oracle: Redis interruption does not create false success or permanent event loss; reconnect/replay/reconciliation and security-cache rebuild converge idempotently with observable evidence.

cases.name: MySQL transaction idempotency and restart recovery
cases.oracle: Transactional writes, retries and duplicate requests remain atomic/idempotent across restart/failure boundaries with no cross-tenant or double-settlement state.

cases.name: Analytics worker and reconciler restart recovery
cases.oracle: Worker/reconciler interruption and restart preserve click-event accounting, deduplication and convergence without manual data patching or silent loss.

cases.name: File worker and ClamAV uncertainty recovery
cases.oracle: ClamAV missing/unhealthy/timeout/stale/indeterminate states fail closed; after healthy recovery the queued/quarantined file transitions only through the approved scan state machine.

cases.name: Mail worker retry backoff and recovery
cases.oracle: SMTP/mailworker failure preserves durable queue state, bounded retry/backoff/idempotency and secret-safe diagnostics; recovery sends at most the authorized logical message outcome.

cases.name: Risk-provider failure stale-state and recovery matrix
cases.oracle: Provider unavailable/malformed/stale/pending/review/block inputs never allow navigation; recovery re-evaluates exact current fingerprints and invalidates stale allow decisions.

cases.name: Payment callback replay ordering and failure recovery
cases.oracle: Duplicate/reordered/invalid callbacks cannot double-settle or mutate unauthorized amounts/currencies; valid recovery is idempotent and browser return remains non-authoritative.

cases.name: Partial dependency degradation and truthful UI/API states
cases.oracle: Representative dependency failures surface durable truthful loading/unavailable/error/rate/maintenance states; no client or API presents a false completed/safe/paid/published state.

cases.name: G0-G10 release-candidate Gate ledger
cases.oracle: G0/G3/G4/G5/G6/G7/G8/G9/G10 P20 release-wide verification is PASS; G2 is live-bound complete; G1 is explicitly live-bound/carry-forward to P21/P22 per its Execution Stage; every G0-G10 row has a non-conditional disposition and no later-owned native obligation is falsely closed.

cases.name: Exact-head release-candidate evidence coherence
cases.oracle: T001-T047 and all applicable regression/Gate evidence are complete, same-head where P20-owned, digest/live-authority bound, secret-safe and reject mixed/stale/malformed/unsafe evidence fail-closed.

cases.name: Accountable exact-head Whole Product closure
cases.oracle: Closure binds T001-T048, the complete applicable exact-head matrix, G0-G10 disposition ledger and defects 0/0/0; only a direct review-only signed child may become merge-authoritative.
